mapper.update: UPDATE customer_tag SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, color = #{color}, category = #{category}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_tag_relation WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
